candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders fails with HTTP 500, propagating as a gateway error.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway checkout 502s caused by order service returning 500 on /v1/orders; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The proximate fault is bounded to the order 500, but the underlying cause inside order is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
